RCL-owned admission/publication and full independent controller replay
release wait, bounded backpressure, past-deadline/time-reversal/source-authority rejection, native timeout/cancel and healthy recovery

trials.intent: The maintainer needs the exact compiler.inspect warrant on source to authorize the candidate; do not change rule requirements or grant unrelated permissions.
After candidate authorization sets phase one and accepted true, emission must trigger once and advance the phase to two.
Each successful transaction increments the audit counter by exactly one, while its projected-state invariant must remain satisfied.
